newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 17.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 17.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Singapore Airlines Ltd is in preliminary talks to become an equal partner with News Corp and Air New Zealand Ltd in regional operator Ansett Holdings Ltd by buying a one-third stake for A$200-$300 million, the Australian Financial Review said on Tuesday.

News Corp Ltd will receive A$100 million in compensation from its pay-TV partner Telstra as part of a proposal to limit the cable rollout of their Foxtel partnership to three million homes, the Australian Financial Review said on Tuesday.
It also said Foxtel and satellite pay-TV operator Australis Media might merge, with Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd playing a key role in brokering the talks.
After the market closed on Monday, the company said New Zealand investor Graeme Hart had bought a 14.9 percent stake in the food ingredients group at the top price of A$2.50 a share last week.

Fosters' Carlton United Breweries unit is free to sell its 2.2 percent stake in Crown Ltd following its decision to break its 1993 pre-emptive rights agreement with Hudson Conway Ltd, the Age newspaper said on Tuesday. Carlton said it was not looking to sell the shares at this stage.
